title: SAPUI5 Explorer
subtitle: Chrome Extension
description: Estensione Chrome per analizzare applicazioni SAPUI5/OpenUI5 nel browser. Estrae informazioni tecniche su componenti, modelli, binding, viste, controller e configurazione runtime. Supporta UI5 1.x e 2.x.
summary: Analizza le app SAPUI5 e OpenUI5 direttamente dal browser.

en.subtitle: Chrome Extension
en.summary: Inspect SAPUI5 and OpenUI5 apps right from the browser.
en.description: A Chrome extension to analyse SAPUI5/OpenUI5 applications in the browser. It extracts technical information about components, models, bindings, views, controllers and runtime configuration. Supports UI5 1.x and 2.x.
